jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Five or more years of experience in infrastructure or systems engineering with substantial hands-on Tier 2–3 responsibility for enterprise server operations, complex incident resolution, and production support Strong administration skills across Linux and Windows Server, VMware or comparable virtualization, cloud compute, SAN/NAS storage, backup and recovery, Active Directory or IPA, and performance monitoring Working knowledge of DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, segmentation, identity, access control, system hardening, vulnerability management, and security incident support

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field 5–10 years of experience in an engineering, operations, or project management role within the semiconductor, photonics, or related technology industry Background in silicon process technologies, semiconductor manufacturing, fabrication, or related areas
